title: Antivirus Defense
description: Be the antivirus! Build firewalls, scanners and quarantine locks to stop rogue AI hackers.
about:
Rogue AI hackers are racing along the data bus toward the computer's core. Install antivirus defenders on the chip sockets: Firewalls, Throttlers, Purge Bombs, Scanners and Quarantine locks.

Upgrade your towers, survive all 10 waves, then see how long you last in endless mode. The leaderboards are shared on F12 Games under a made-up nickname.
